results.title: 120 volunteers remove sludge, restore 80 flood-hit homes across upper Assam
results.description: Led by a Jorhat social worker, the volunteers are restoring flood-hit homes free of cost, repairing electrical and water connections across Upper Assam.

results.title: Infantino gets Mexico and Argentina's support as UEFA, AFC stick to its stand
results.description: FIFA President Gianni Infantino faces mounting criticism over a controversial World Cup commercial rights proposal, with Mexico and Argentina backing him while UEFA and others push for boycotts. FIFA admits errors but insists governance rules were followed, as global football bodies clash ahead of March elections.

results.title: Brendon McCullum backs Harry Brook to captain England’s Test team in future
results.description: Former England red-ball coach Brendon McCullum believes Harry Brook will eventually captain the Test side despite Joe Root's reappointment following Ben Stokes' retirement. McCullum also praised Stephen Fleming, who will take over as England's full-time Test head coach in December.

results.title: Class 9 pass founder hired a taxi driver who now leads procurement
results.description: A Hyderabad founder hired a taxi driver with limited education as his first employee. He invested in the individual, believing in his potential for growth. This employee, after a decade, now leads the company's procurement department. His responsibilities now span across India, showcasing significant professional development. The founder highlighted that culture involves hiring overlooked talent and investing in them.
